proposed_relationship: Combining cancer vaccines with small-molecule inhibitors of IDO may enhance T-cell function in the tumor microenvironment.
mechanism: The mechanism underlying this proposed relationship is that IDO inhibitors would prevent the degradation of tryptophan by IDO, thereby reducing the suppression of T-cell function in the tumor microenvironment, and allowing the cancer vaccine-activated T-cells to effectively target the tumor.
constraint_released: The use of IDO inhibitors would release the constraint imposed by IDO-mediated immune suppression on cancer vaccine efficacy.
